premises.text: Many people in countries like Argentina, Brazil, and Venezuela are unbanked and lack access to credit.
premises.evidence_span: most of the population in this country is unbanked and also doesn't have access to credit

premises.text: The lack of access to credit makes online payments difficult for consumers.
premises.evidence_span: this makes it very difficult to pay online, but impossible to do it in the most common way to do a payment online, which is on credit

premises.text: RepioCredit allows users to pay online in installments using local currency.
premises.evidence_span: With RepioCredit, our users can pay online on installments in local currency

premises.text: The app uses personal information and photos to verify user identity for credit approval.
premises.evidence_span: give us some personal information and two photos to verify your identity

premises.text: A scoring system is built using user data and external sources to approve credit.
premises.evidence_span: With all this information, we build a score that helps us give credit to the user

premises.text: Users can pay their monthly statements through bank accounts or cash at partnered merchant locations.
premises.evidence_span: the user is going to have a monthly statement like a credit card will have, and they can see it on their phone

premises.text: There is a significant market opportunity with over 200 million unbanked individuals in Latin America.
premises.evidence_span: There is more than 200 million banks across Latin America, and this is a very huge global problem

value.text: Consumers can make online purchases using Bitcoin and local currency through affordable installments.
value.evidence_span: pay on credit on affordable installments in local currency
